name: chatlog
description: Records every prompt, answer and tool call of a Claude Code session to .claude/chatlog in real time (Markdown + text + JSONL), including interrupts, exits, /clear and resume, and replays a log in terminal style

formats.title: Readable formats
formats.description: Readable files written beside the JSONL log (the JSONL is always written; replay reads it).

gitignore.title: Keep logs out of git
gitignore.description: Write .claude/chatlog/.gitignore (ignore everything) when the folder is first created.

redact.title: Mask secrets
redact.description: Mask API keys, tokens, private keys and password=... values before they reach disk.
